title: Numista Country Coverage Progress
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=coin:item
| stats dc(country) as countries count as coins by era_name
| sort 0 - countries
value: Country coverage shows whether the collection is broadening or just deepening in the same places.
implementation: Send country coverage events to `index=personal` and keep `era_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of country coverage by eras.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals which erass stand out most for country coverage.
